parts.text: My colleague Arthur BIT-MONNOT and I offer a PhD position in our team RIS at LAAS-CNRS in Toulouse (

), before April the 16th:
- complete CV
- details about your Master internship
- complete transcript of records, especially at Master level
- a letter of motivation
- letters of recommendation if any

(Fluency in French is not mandatory, but good writing and oral skills in English are.)
